description:
Risk profile for one market, for the moment before capital is committed.

Use this when a specific market has been chosen and the question is whether to go ahead. It is the one tool that answers 'what else should I know besides the rate'.

Use something else when: you are still choosing between markets (`list_base_yields`, `best_yield`); you only want to know whether the rate moved (`yield_history`); you need the deposit address (`list_lending_vaults`).

Prerequisite: the market must be on this server's shelf — a vault, reserve or pool from `list_lending_vaults`. Arbitrary pool ids from `list_base_yields` will not resolve.

Returns `score` (0-100) and `band` ('solid', 'fair', 'thin' or 'fragile'), plus a `signals` object holding the six inputs behind it: size (TVL), track_record (days running), stability (APY volatility from daily snapshots), yield_quality (share of the APY that is borrower interest rather than incentives that can stop), cost (the curator's percentage cut) and diversification (share sitting in the largest position). Each signal carries its raw value and its sub-score, and `method.weights` gives the weighting, so the score can be recomputed. A signal lacking data reports score null and is excluded from the weighting rather than guessed at. Pair with `yield_history` for an unusually high rate. Describes what has happened, not what will.

pool.description: Vault symbol, vault address, or protocol-asset — e.g. 'sparkusdc', 'aave-usdc', '0x7BfA7C4f149E7415b73bdeDfe609237e29CBF34A'

name: market_profile
title: What to weigh besides the rate
